How it works
At a glance

Quantum-private payments in stablecoins, tokens and NFTs, one deployment per country. Hidden from the public, never from that country's auditor, which can read but not freeze or move anyone's funds.

You, in this tab

Your passkey unlocks your keys. They stay in this tab. Or your custody wallet approves each step.

a proof, or a signed request

The relayer

Submits it and pays the gas, an approval's too, which you pay back in $RLS, shielded or public. Sends and $RLS unshields never show your address as the sender. Swaps run through Rayls' own notes. Its custody signer proves what a custody wallet approved.
